narration: In month {fork_month}, the roof at home needed work before the monsoon, your parents raised it twice and asked for nothing, and you chose {real_choice}. The ghost took {ghost_choice}, and the first score to part was {first_bar_apart}, that same month. The ghost's money touched its lowest in month {ghost_lowest_month}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. In the ghost's life, more of each month's pay was claimed before it arrived, and its Freedom ended {freedom_gap}. At month {end_month}, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
